node: Housing repair/remodel contractor supply, specialty distributors, restoration products, equipment rental, and dealer networks
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the contractor-supply capacity node. The clearest public mappings are not pure consumer brands but specialty distributors, equipment-rental networks, and regional dealer/service platforms that sit between housing repair/remodel demand and contractor productivity. Reference leaders include national distribution or rental platforms with visible contractor exposure; the underfollowed lane includes smaller building-products distributors and equipment-dealer networks whose exposure may be hidden under industrial distribution or rental classifications. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
